claims.text:
19. kernel-trick

Target / packet: ai-kernel-trick · C3. Prerequisites: ai:svm-widest-margin.

Nearest / distinct payoff: svm-widest-margin → ai-svm-widest-margin. The earlier admitted lesson separates points with a linear boundary; this computes a nonlinear feature-space dot product from a kernel without explicitly materializing the features. Distinct from claiming every kernel is valid or training an SVM.

Finite primary model: One-dimensional inputs x=[-1,0,1] have labels[1,-1,1]. Feature map phi(x)=[x,x²]. Decision phi_2-.5 is positive at the two outer points and negative at0; a single raw-x threshold cannot produce that label pattern. Kernel K(x,z)=xz+x²z² equals dot(phi(x),phi(z)). The three-point Gram matrix is[[2,0,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,2]].

Countercase and mathematical boundary: At x=2,z=1, direct feature dot and kernel both give6. At x=.5,z=-1, K=-.25: a negative off-diagonal value is allowed, while this kernel's positive semidefiniteness follows from its explicit feature inner product. Do not declare an arbitrary similarity a valid kernel. The zero-feature input0 is legitimate; no Gram-matrix inversion or trained optimal margin is claimed.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict whether moving to squared features can separate the displayed alternating labels. Recall calculate K(2,1)=6 and explain which computation can be done without storing both feature coordinates.

Required observable evidence: Show three raw points, transformed coordinates and one selected dot product/kernel equality at a time. Do not turn the lesson into a memorized XOR label quiz or claim these two feature coordinates save computation in this tiny example.

Source obligation: [Maintainer SVM custom-kernel and mathematical formulation](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/svm.htmlcustom-kernels), body acquired in30b; [author GPML chapter2 §2.1](https://gaussianprocess.org/gpml/chapters/RW2.pdf), body acquired this run, describes the weight/feature-space route. Local feature and kernel identities must be independently reproduced. No copied figures or broad efficiency guarantee.
